form.billing_kind_one_time_hint: Student charged once at enrollment signup. No further invoices on this enrollment.
form.billing_kind_recurring_hint: Billed every cycle. Enrollment auto-renews until withdrawn.
form.billing_kind_contract_hint: Fixed-term enrollment with a defined end date. Can bill periodically within the term or as a single total at signup.
form.billing_kind_milestone_hint: Invoice fires per milestone (enrollment term) as deliverables complete. Requires a Curriculum on the parent Level.
form.billing_kind_ad_hoc_hint: Operator-requested sessions. Choose Total Level for a prepaid package or Per session for pay-per-session.
form.amount_basis_per_cycle_hint: Amount charged each billing cycle. Required for Recurring and Term-with-cycle enrollments.
form.amount_basis_total_package_hint: Single total amount charged across the full enrollment term. One invoice covers everything; no per-cycle billing.
form.amount_basis_derived_from_lines_hint: Total computed automatically from the per-subject fee-schedule rows. Amount input is hidden when this is selected.
form.amount_basis_per_occurrence_hint: Amount charged per delivered session. Per-session enrollments only — each session fires its own invoice.
form.entitled_occurrences_info: Number of sessions included in the prepaid package. Required when amount basis is Total Level on a Per-session enrollment.
form.term_open_ended_help: Leave empty for open-ended / no expiration
form.schedule_locked_tooltip: This academic year is reserved for {{.ClientName}}.
form.schedule_auto_create_hint: No academic year exists for {{.ClientName}} yet — one will be created automatically when you save.
form.schedule_auto_reuse_hint: This level will be added to the existing academic year for {{.ClientName}}.
form.schedule_client_picker_notice: Only levels assigned to this student are available below.
form.schedule_general_picker_notice: Levels assigned specifically to students are not available for assignment to general-scoped academic years.
form.parent_schedule_client_notice: This academic year belongs to {{.ClientName}}. Levels created here will be available only for enrollments with this student.

product_price.empty_msg: No subject fees have been configured for this academic year yet.

messages.pricing_locked_reason: This level is in use by active enrollments. Pricing changes are disabled. You can still rename or reassign the level.
messages.item_pricing_locked_reason: This level is in use by active enrollments. Subject fee and currency are locked to keep billing consistent.
messages.create_not_available: Subject fee plan create is not available.
messages.update_not_available: Subject fee plan update is not available.
messages.delete_not_available: Subject fee plan delete is not available.
messages.in_use_cannot_modify: This level is in use by active enrollments. Subject fee and currency are locked.

per_cycle.customer: Charged {{.Amount}} every {{.CycleLabel}}. Enrollment auto-renews until withdrawn.
per_cycle.operations: Each cycle spawns {{.VisitsPerCycle}} Course(s) (if Level has a Curriculum). Course Plans tab shows cycle accordions.
per_cycle.revenue: One invoice per cycle. Generate Invoice creates the invoice and (via piggyback) spawns the Course if missing.

derived_from_lines.operations: Each cycle spawns 1+ Courses. Course tracking flows through the Level's Curriculum.
derived_from_lines.revenue: Invoice total computed from academic year lines; one invoice per cycle.

total_package.operations: Enrollment spawns 1 lifetime Course (or cycle Courses if cyclic — see Level's visits_per_cycle).
total_package.revenue: One invoice at signup; cycle Courses are operational only.

total_package.operations: Lifetime Course with terms. BillingEvent rows gate per-milestone invoicing.
total_package.revenue: Invoice per milestone trigger; sum across milestones equals the total level.

total_package.operations: Enrollment spawns 1 lifetime Course with terms (if Level has a Curriculum).
total_package.revenue: One invoice at enrollment signup covering the full amount.

total_package.operations: Operator requests each session from the Course Plans tab. Package exhausts after {{.EntitledOccurrences}} sessions — operator can extend.
total_package.revenue: One invoice at enrollment signup covering the entire package; subsequent sessions are operationally tracked only.

per_occurrence.customer: Charged {{.Amount}} per session. No upfront cost.
per_occurrence.operations: Operator requests each session from the Course Plans tab. Each completed session flips its BillingEvent to READY for invoicing.
per_occurrence.revenue: One invoice per delivered session. Generate Invoice per session row.

warning.milestone_no_template: Milestone billing requires the Level to have a Curriculum. Configure it on the Level first.
warning.recurring_no_template: This enrollment will not have course tracking. Add a Curriculum to the Level to enable cycle Courses.
warning.visits_per_cycle_invalid_kind: visits_per_cycle is only valid for cyclic levels. Reset to 1 or change the billing kind.
warning.ad_hoc_pool_no_template: Per-session package enrollments require a Curriculum so sessions can be tracked.
warning.ad_hoc_per_call_no_template: Per-session enrollments require a Curriculum so sessions can be tracked.
warning.ad_hoc_no_entitlement: Per-session package enrollments need entitled sessions > 0. Set the value or switch to per-session billing.
warning.ad_hoc_billing_cycle_not_allowed: Per-session enrollments are event-driven, not calendar-driven. Remove the billing cycle.
warning.ad_hoc_visits_per_cycle_not_allowed: Per-session enrollments cannot use multi-session cycles. Reset visits_per_cycle to 1.

subscriptions.empty_message: Enrollments billing this level will appear here.
subscriptions.confirm_delete_message: Are you sure you want to delete enrollment %s? This action cannot be undone.

confirms.edit_amount_multiple_subscriptions: This academic year is attached to {{.Count}} active enrollments for {{.ClientName}}. Changing the amount or cycle will affect all of them on the next bill cycle. Continue?

errors.in_use: This level is in use by active enrollments and cannot be deleted.
errors.schedule_client_mismatch: Selected academic year belongs to a different student and cannot be attached to this level pricing.
errors.schedule_required_for_client_scope: This level is scoped to a student. Pick or create an academic year for that student before adding level pricing.

validation.milestone_cyclic_block: Milestone billing is not supported on cyclic levels (RECURRING / CONTRACT × PER_CYCLE / multi-session).
validation.ad_hoc_invalid_basis: Per-session enrollments require amount basis = Total Level (package) or Per session.
validation.ad_hoc_billing_incompatible_with_cycle_c: Per-session enrollments cannot have a billing cycle.
validation.ad_hoc_visits_per_cycle_must_be_one: Per-session enrollments cannot use multi-session cycles.
validation.ad_hoc_pool_no_template: Per-session package enrollments require the Level to have a Curriculum.
validation.ad_hoc_per_call_no_template: Per-session enrollments require the Level to have a Curriculum.
validation.ad_hoc_entitlement_required: Per-session package enrollments require entitled sessions > 0.
validation.ad_hoc_entitlement_invalid_for_per_call: Entitled sessions are only valid on package enrollments, not per-session.
